# Reset MAF sensor fuel trim tables

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Clean MAF internals and run briefly unplugged before plugging back in to clear codes. [t338]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Clean the Mass Air Flow (MAF) sensor internals with electrical contact cleaner.
2. Start the engine while the MAF connector is unplugged to let it run briefly without input.
3. Shut off the engine and plug the MAF sensor back in securely.
4. Clear any stored trouble codes using a scanner.

_Procedure reported by [t338]._

## Tips & gotchas

- This procedure forces a Long Term Fuel Trim (LTFT) table reset, allowing the ECU to relearn fuel trends based on cleaner sensor data. [t338]
